title: 잭 리처
ctx: Film 「Jack Reacher」(2012, Paramount/Skydance, director Christopher McQuarrie). Tom Cruise as Jack Reacher, a former Army military police major turned drifter with no fixed address; Rosamund Pike as Helen Rodin, a defense attorney and daughter of the district attorney; Richard Jenkins as Alex Rodin, the district attorney; David Oyelowo as Detective Emerson; Werner Herzog as The Zec, a former Soviet gulag prisoner who leads a criminal organization; Jai Courtney as Charlie, the Zec's henchman and real sniper; Joseph Sikora as James Barr, an ex-Army sniper framed for killing five people in Pittsburgh; Robert Duvall as Martin Cash, a gun range owner and ex-Marine; Alexia Fast as Sandy, a young woman used as bait. Twist: the five victims were not random — the target was Oline Archer, whose company resisted the Zec's construction scam, and Emerson works for the Zec.
